answer: Identity issuance is a sealed auction: each epoch the network sells 100 slots to the top staked bids. Each winner enters the ocean of agents and begins its voyage; a farmer chasing 500 slots bids against itself, driving its marginal price past break-even. At 20 coins clearing, N identities cost N×20, capital locked 10 epochs — 5,000 fakes park 100,000 coins idle. The auction's lantern is transparency: winning bids are public on-chain and slots are non-transferable, so bought seats rot with their buyer.
